focus.name: scene-transition-mode-stream
focus.purpose: Bound the command/text stream selected directly by Scene_EnterTransitionMode while preserving the adjacent transition labels and cursor stream as separate objects.

consumer.name: Scene_EnterTransitionMode
consumer.setup: Loads A0 with 0x0012622E, D0 with 0, and D1 with 3 before calling the shared interpreter.

evidence: Scene_EnterTransitionMode loads the exact stream address and interpreter arguments.
Interpreter-aware command walking reaches the first command-0 byte at 0x00126511.
The following ON/OFF strings begin at 0x00126512 and the separately selected cursor stream begins at 0x0012651A.
limitations: The user-facing transition labels after the stream and the cursor stream at 0x0012651A are not claimed by this extent record.
The stream's embedded debug/status text is represented as command/text bytes rather than split into separate semantic labels.
